chemistry-killer-01.title: Ukulondolozwa kobunzima, umlinganiselo ongatshintshiyo, i-exothermic ne-endothermic
chemistry-killer-01.topic: Ukulondolozwa kobunzima, umlinganiselo ongatshintshiyo, i-exothermic ne-endothermic
chemistry-killer-01.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-01.material:
Impuphu yekopolo (Cu) itshiswa nge-oxygen ($\mathrm{O_2}$) kwisikhongozeli esivaliweyo ukwenza i-copper(II) oxide ($\mathrm{CuO}$). Kuyo yonke imifuniselo isikhongozeli sinee-2.0 g ze-$\mathrm{O_2}$, kwaye intsabela yi-$\mathrm{2Cu + O_2 \rightarrow 2CuO}$. Ubunzima be-CuO obwenziweyo bu:
(A) Cu 4.0 g -> CuO 5.0 g
(B) Cu 8.0 g -> CuO 10.0 g
(C) Cu 12.0 g -> CuO 10.0 g
Umthetho wemilinganiselo echanekileyo uyasebenza phantsi kweemeko ezifanayo. Kwisikhongozeli esifanayo, i-14.0 g ye-Cu kunye ne-4.0 g ye-$\mathrm{O_2}$ zisabelisa de enye isabelayo iphele. Sesiphi isiphumo esichanekileyo?
chemistry-killer-01.thinking.0: Ukulondolozwa kobunzima, umlinganiselo ongatshintshiyo, i-exothermic ne-endothermic
chemistry-killer-01.s.s1.prompt:
Impuphu yekopolo (Cu) itshiswa nge-oxygen ($\mathrm{O_2}$) kwisikhongozeli esivaliweyo ukwenza i-copper(II) oxide ($\mathrm{CuO}$). Kuyo yonke imifuniselo isikhongozeli sinee-2.0 g ze-$\mathrm{O_2}$, kwaye intsabela yi-$\mathrm{2Cu + O_2 \rightarrow 2CuO}$. Ubunzima be-CuO obwenziweyo bu:
(A) Cu 4.0 g -> CuO 5.0 g
(B) Cu 8.0 g -> CuO 10.0 g
(C) Cu 12.0 g -> CuO 10.0 g
Umthetho wemilinganiselo echanekileyo uyasebenza phantsi kweemeko ezifanayo. Kwisikhongozeli esifanayo, i-14.0 g ye-Cu kunye ne-4.0 g ye-$\mathrm{O_2}$ zisabelisa de enye isabelayo iphele. Sesiphi isiphumo esichanekileyo?
chemistry-killer-01.s.s1.explain:
